decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house at least one 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobin has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.
Condition : 4 - The ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 6 - The extract system hereby approved shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher.The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 12 midday to midnight on Monday till Saturday and 12 midday until 11pm on Sunday.

Condition : 8 - 7	The use hereby permitted for a restaurant (A3 use) shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the restaurant and the residential flats above, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of use from retail (A1) to restaurant (A3), the rebuilding of part of the single storey rear extension and the erection of a ventilation flue
